QuestInfo.name: [Sia Astelle] John and the Horned Conch
QuestInfo.0: The Spirit King's blessing carried you to Lith Harbor. A constellation must be nearby--search for traces.
QuestInfo.1: You heard rumors that John had fished up something amazing and went to hear his story, only to realize that he had clearly found #p9402191#. He offered to give #p9402191# back to you, in exchange for a rare item from the other side of the Interdimensional Portal. It's time for a journey!
QuestInfo.2: To get #p9402191#, you crossed dimensions through the Interdimensional Portal.
